# 🚀 Cosmic Pancake Adventure

## How to Play
1. **Launch the game** and select your pancake pilot
2. **Tilt your device** to steer through asteroid syrup fields
3. **Tap to boost** past space whales and collect star sprinkles
4. **Avoid black hole pancake presses** - they're extra crispy on the other side!
5. **Reach the Cosmic Diner** to unlock the legendary Golden Syrup

Collect 100 star sprinkles to activate **PANCAKE RAGE MODE** - everything flips!
